subject: HelixCare pilot moved to waitlist — request to reschedule demo/check-in
messages:
From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@helixcare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@helixcare.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling — Redwood inference pilot

Sean —

Thanks for the fast turnaround on the demo materials last week and for walking our engineering leads through the latency/cost estimates. Weve done an internal prioritization pass and, for the next two quarters, our product roadmap has pulled work away from the inference initiative.

Short version: we need to pause the demo and move the pilot to a waitlist while we finish a Q3 core-platform launch. Theres also a VP-level travel window (leadership offsite) that makes scheduling a meaningful technical review difficult until late Q3.

I attached a very high-level snapshot of our roadmap and priorities so you can see the context (HelixCare_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf).

Can we:
- Move our planned 1:1 demo to a tentative Q4 slot?
- Keep the POC paperwork/nondisclosure active so we dont have to re-run procurement when we come back?
- Schedule a quick 30-minute check-in in ~90 days to reassess timing?

Were still interested — this is a timing/prioritization move rather than a no. Appreciate your flexibility here.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Morgan
Head of Data, HelixCare
alyssa.morgan@helixcare.com

---attachment: HelixCare_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@helixcare.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling — Redwood inference pilot

Alyssa — thanks for the context and the roadmap snapshot — super helpful. Totally understand the runway squeeze and the leadership travel window.

Proposed approach:
- Ill mark the demo as tentatively moved to Q4 on our side and add the note to the deal record (HLC-2391).
- Well keep your NDA and procurement thread open so nothing needs to be re-signed; Monica (ccd) will keep the contract documents in warm storage.
- Ill schedule a 30-minute check-in 90 days out (asked calendar hold, subject to acceptance). If Q4 is still tight, we can move to a monthly 15-min sync cadence instead.

Optional to help preserve runway: if its useful, we can offer a short technical office hours session for your infra team (20–30 mins) while theyre available, so were not starting blind when you come back. No formal demo, just Q/A and integration pointers.

Let me know if the Q4 tentative move and the check-in cadence works. Ill follow up with Monica on the procurement/NDA hold.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa.morgan@helixcare.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling — Redwood inference pilot

Sean — this plan works for us. Please:
1) Put a tentative Q4 demo week in for now (well firm up dates after our sprint planning on June 15).
2) Keep procurement paperwork/warm NDA comment as you suggested. Legal has no concerns at the moment (ccd in my first note).
3) Wed take you up on a 20-minute office hours slot later in July if your team is available — that would help our infra team validate assumptions.

Thanks for being flexible. Ill accept the 90-day check-in calendar hold once Im back at my desk.

— Alyssa

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelixCare — pilot moved to waitlist (action items)

Monica / Ben — forwarding the customer thread. Key asks:
- Move HLC-2391 to "nurture/waitlist" pipeline stage in HubSpot and set a 90-day follow-up task (Sean).
- Keep NDA/procurement docs active and attached to the deal (Monica).
- Customer may want a short technical office hours in July for infra — please confirm availability and a staffer (Monica).
- On pricing/credits: Alyssas not asking for concessions, but to keep momentum Id propose we be willing to offer a $5k pilot credit or a 2-week evaluation environment if they want a hands-on try later in Q4. Ben, can you approve that as a discretionary pilot credit or should we escalate to pricing?

Alyssas note: "were still interested — timing/prioritization move rather than a no." Good lead to keep warm.

Thanks — Ill update the HubSpot record once I get confirmation on the credit.

— Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
